annotation.description: The first frame shows a women hugging a men with some kind of door with a grid. Both are bold. He wears a grey longsleeve and holds her. She wears a black long sleeve. In the second frame they both wear something on their head and are sitting on a black couch with a yellow wall in the background. She wears a white head with some kind of flower on the left side and smiles. He wears a purple crocheted head and looks less happy.
